hypotheses.scope: Whether rendered-and-Watch-observed dream media adds measurable value beyond text-only dream, direct memory, or structured reflection.

hypotheses.retained_subsystem_scope: Retain rendered media/Watch observations for historical audit, creative review, and separately authorized preregistered replications only; do not place provider media on the cognitive critical path from this result.

hypotheses.scope: Local P2 continuity reliability under one workstation configuration, covering the 35-cycle no-restart soak and the seven-scenario restart/stale-session recovery campaign.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: 35 no-restart cycles plus seven preregistered restart/stale-session recovery scenarios
hypotheses.raw_effect: 35/35 no-restart cycles passed with Wilson 95% lower bound 0.901096; 7/7 recovery scenarios passed with 6 live service restarts and zero duplicate accepted effects.
hypotheses.what_it_proves: The local live P2 continuity chain completed 35 no-restart cycles, and the local recovery campaign retained seven hash-bound restart/stale-session receipts without duplicate accepted effects.
hypotheses.what_it_does_not_prove: Production reliability, cloud or multi-region disaster recovery, paid provider/video repeatability, or human-perceived value.
hypotheses.retained_subsystem_scope: Use as scoped local reliability and recovery evidence only; do not generalize beyond tested services and fault points.

transfer_outcomes.reason: No downstream adoption is warranted by a workstation-local no-restart reliability result.

hypotheses.successor_or_retirement_action: Keep constrained to local workstation services; require a new preregistered campaign before any production reliability claim.
hypotheses.review_condition: Re-evaluate only for a new deployment or production-reliability claim.
